      Our Story — From Travel to Phin Coffee Hoi  An

      A journey shaped by travel, Vietnamese coffee, food and the people we’ve met along the way.tpat.

      From Tour Leader to Coffee Shop Owner

      Before Phin Coffee, travel was already a big part of my life. I spent many years working in tourism, leading trips through Vietnam and Indochina and meeting people from different cultures along the way.

      Those years also brought me closer to Vietnamese coffee. Through my travels, I met coffee farmers, café owners and people who were passionate about what they grew and brewed. I became curious about what happens before coffee reaches the cup — from the farm and processing to roasting and brewing.

      In 2017, Anh and I turned that curiosity into our first Phin Coffee Hoi An shop. We started small, learning every day from making coffee, working with our team and talking with travellers who came through our doors.

      What started as one coffee shop gradually became a much bigger journey — but our curiosity about coffee, food and hospitality has stayed at the heart of Phin.

      2017 · Hoi An · The beginning of Phin Coffee

      Meet the People Behind Phin

      Phin has always been a family business. Behind the coffee, food, classes and daily operations are two different roles that have grown together over the years.

      Thinh Bui

      Coffee, Roasting & Experiences

      Thinh’s curiosity about coffee grew through years of travel and eventually took him deeper into beans, processing and roasting. Today, he works on Phin’s coffee roasting and shares what he has learned through our coffee experiences and with guests from around the world.

      Anh Vuong

      Operations, People & Finance

      Anh is behind much of what keeps Phin moving every day. She manages operations across our locations, works closely with the team and oversees the financial side of the business as it continues to grow.

      Different roles, one family business — built together in Hoi An since 2017.

      How Phin Coffee Hoi An Grew

      What began with one small coffee shop in Hoi An gradually grew with our curiosity — into new places, our own roastery and different ways to share Vietnamese coffee, food and hospitality.

      Phin Coffee Restaurant — Hoi An Old Town

      Our original Phin story continues in our new home in Hoi An Old Town, bringing together Vietnamese coffee, food and hospitality.

      Phin Lounge — An Bang

      A relaxed garden café near An Bang Beach, where coffee, food and our Vietnamese Coffee Master Class come together.

      Phin Lab Roastery — Triêm Tây Village

      Where we work more deeply with coffee — roasting, tasting and learning how each batch develops from green bean to cup.

      Phin Brunch — Hoi An

      A casual place built around breakfast, brunch and coffee, adding another side to the Phin family.

      Our Curiosity Didn’t Stop at Brewing

      Making coffee every day made us more curious about what happens before it reaches the cup. We wanted to understand the beans themselves — where they are grown, how they are processed and how roasting changes their character.

      That curiosity eventually took us into roasting. At Phin Lab Roastery, we work with Vietnamese coffee, experiment with roast profiles and follow how each batch develops through colour, aroma and taste.

      Roasting changed the way we understand coffee — and the way we share it with others. It allows us to connect the whole journey: farm → processing → roasting → brewing → cup, and to understand the story behind each batch along the way.

      From green bean to roast to cup — there is always more to discover.

      DISCOVER OUR COFFEE →

      Food Became Part of the Story

      Phin began with coffee, but food gradually became another part of our curiosity.

      During the long break of the pandemic, when normal café life suddenly slowed down, we had something we rarely had before — time to experiment. We spent it in the kitchen, learning and developing things we had always wanted to try, from smoking duck and making our own ham to learning more about bread making.

      Some of those experiments stayed with us when the doors opened again. They became part of the way we cook at Phin today — alongside the Hoi An and Vietnamese dishes that have always connected us to where we live.

      Our food now reflects both sides of that journey: local flavours and traditions we grew up around, together with ideas we’ve picked up through travel, experimentation and years of cooking for our guests.

      DISCOVER OUR FOOD →

      More Than Coffee and Food

      Long before Phin, hospitality was already part of my life. After nearly 20 years working in tourism, I had spent countless days travelling with people from around the world, sharing places, meals and stories along the way.

      Those years taught me that people often remember more than what they ate, drank or saw. They remember the people they met, the conversations they had and how a place made them feel.

      That idea has stayed with us at Phin. Whether someone joins us for a coffee, a meal or a coffee experience, we want them to leave with more than what was in the cup or on the plate — we want them to take a little story of Hoi An with them.

      Coffee and food bring people to the table. The people around it make the memory.

      Come and Experience Phin for Yourself

      Our story continues every day through the coffee we roast, the food we cook, the people we work with and the guests we welcome to Hoi An.
